rows.title: UK Approval of Wegovy Pill Marks Game-Changing Moment for Slimmers
rows.title_en: UK Approval of Wegovy Pill Marks Game-Changing Moment for Slimmers
rows.summary: The UK has approved a new pill form of Wegovy, a weight-loss medication that has been hailed as a game-changer for slimmers. The pill, which contains the same appetite-suppressing ingredient as the injection, is expected to have a monumental take-up rate, with recent polling suggesting that twice as many patients would be willing to take a weight-loss tablet as injections. Patients have reported remarkable improvements, with one woman losing over 15lb in just two months.
